title: The three pillars: metrics, logs and traces

videos.script: A customer presses pay. One and a half seconds later the shop says thank you. Nothing failed, and the customer noticed anyway. {{slow}} Where did those seconds go? From the outside, you cannot tell. The shop answers, and that is all it says. {{outside}} This course starts from that silence. A system tells you only what someone made it tell. So you will make it tell, by instrumenting the service yourself. {{instrument}} This lesson shows the same slow checkout three ways. As a metric, a number that says how many requests were slow. As a log line, an event with fields. And as a trace, the request's path through four services, with the time each one took. {{three}} By the end you will know what each signal is for. And you will have the lab running: a small shop and everything that watches it, on one machine. {{lab}}
